document_text: This agreement shall indemnify the contracting party against all liability arising from third-party claims. Any disputes between the parties shall be resolved through binding arbitration under the rules of the American Arbitration Association. The vendor warrants that all deliverables will meet the agreed specification at the time of delivery. Termination for cause requires thirty days written notice and an opportunity to cure. Liquidated damages of 5% of contract value apply for each week of delay beyond the agreed milestone date. The receiving party agrees to maintain strict confidentiality of all disclosed information for a period of five years.
